name: aiwos-video
description: video-brief: turn a real job into a 30-60s script, shot list, on-screen text and caption rules, ready to hand to a video builder. Plus check-captions.py, a deterministic SRT/VTT lint. demo-video-edit: edit a raw recording into a tight cut (restarts and silences out, cue-word zooms, sound effects, animated cards, decode check, raw vs cut length) and save each timestamped note as a rule.
